title: Not Eligible | Outside Limitation (366 days) | Code 64 Crew Shortage | Delay 6�9h (7h) | APPR | Basic Aeroplan
description:
Customer files a claim for a flight that occurred MORE than 1 year (366 days) ago. Under APPR, the limitation period for filing compensation claims is 1 year from the date of the disrupted travel. This claim was filed 420 days after travel � 54 days past the deadline. The disruption was Code 64 (Flight Crew Shortage � Controllable) with a 7-hour arrival delay (6�<9h band, normally $700 CAD Tier 2). Passenger holds a Basic Aeroplan profile linked to the booking. Validates: (1) DDS correctly calculates the number of days between the travel date and the filing date, (2) The 366-day (1-year) limitation is strictly enforced with no grace period, (3) Even though the disruption was controllable Code 64 with a 7h delay (normally $700 CAD Tier 2), the limitation override blocks eligibility entirely, (4) The time limit check occurs as a PRE-DDS gate � limitation exceeded means result is always NE regardless of code or delay band, (5) Basic Aeroplan profile is recognized but AC Wallet is NOT offered as the case is not eligible, (6) Tests that the system correctly handles stale claims from customers who discover their rights long after travel.

Prerequisites:
PNR: TC039 � single passenger Luc Bergeron (Adult - Basic Aeroplan Member). Journey: 1 leg AC operated, Flight AC 331, YUL?YYZ (domestic). Travel date: May 1, 2025 (over 13 months ago). Filing date: June 15, 2026. Days since travel: May 1, 2025 ? June 15, 2026 = 420 days (exceeds 366-day limit by 54 days). APPR limitation: 366 days (1 year). Disruption: 7h delay (6�<9h band). Arrival delay code: 64 (Flight Crew Shortage � Controllable). Scheduled arrival: 14:00. Actual arrival: 21:00 (+7h). Regime: APPR (domestic). Timing: >72hrs elapsed (obviously, 420 days). Aeroplan: Linked (9876543210), Basic Member in good standing. Key point: Despite controllable Code 64 with 7h delay (normally $700 CAD Tier 2), claim is time-barred. AC Wallet NOT offered (NE case). CyberSource: NOT invoked. RDS: No flags.
